test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

**'Rapid'** may be replaced by ' ______'.
solution: The correct answer is **"Speedy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Rapid"** means fast or quick. (द्रुत (गति से होने वाला) या द्रुतगामी) • **Example:** *She made **rapid**__ progress and was soon the best in the class.* • **"Speedy"** means fast or quick. (तेज़, द्रुतगामी; शीघ्र, तत्‍काल) __ • **Example:** *They hope to bring a **speedy**__ end to the conflict.* • 'Rapid' may be replaced by **'Speedy.'** • The correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Gradual"** means happening slowly over time. 9मंद गति से लंबी कालावधि में संपन्‍न; एकाएक नहीं, क्रमिक) • **"Legitimate"** means lawful or valid. (तर्कसंगत या स्‍वीकार्य) • **"Artistic"** means related to art or creativity. (कला-संबंधी) 15f:T6ad, The correct answer is** Option (1) **i.e.** "ABCD."**
